List even m with φ(m)≤8: v₂=1:{2,6,10,14,18,30}, v₂=2:{4,12,20}, v₂=3:{8,24}, v₂=4:{16}. For each group, count subsets S with total degree D≤8. Each gives 2·(9−D) α’s (sign±, shift c∈[0,8−D]).
